page.notes: Part 1 of 2: the right edge of the page is cut off, so the ends of lines and the rest of the running head are missing. The woodcut initial is read as the first letter of "Ðis". Several words in the Anglo-Saxon text are doubtful and not marked individually; the transcription of the first paragraph is uncertain throughout. Right-hand text is cut off at the edge; the printed line ends are partly lost. The margin note at the foot is set in small type; its mark f is read from the text. Catchword "furtna" at lower right is a catchword as printed, read as "furtna" with doubt.
